propositions: The completion verifier returns non-deterministic verdicts (PASS vs FAIL) for identical inputs within minutes with no code changes between runs, making the close gate unreliable in both directions: false negatives (spuriously blocks legitimate work) and false positives (spuriously passes incomplete work).

Test-existence criteria are marked unmet due to flawed free-form search logic: the verifier cannot reliably locate tests by semantic/regex queries and incorrectly concludes tests do not exist when they do (e.g., searches by phrase '.*verify.*sign window' miss literal test file names like *_4de6.py and test symbols).

The COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar payload lacks structural diagnosability: it does not persist verified_at_sha, trace_id, or model settings (temperature/seed), preventing post-hoc proof that identical input produced different verdicts.
LLM model sampling runs without pinned deterministic decoding (temperature and seed), allowing per-run variance to flip borderline test-existence judgments.
